entries.title: A git check that runs out of time no longer leaves programs running
entries.body: When the app stopped a git command because your project's host did not answer in time, two of git's helper programs kept running, each holding a connection to the host until the host closed it. Every retry added two more. The app now stops them together with git.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how the app stops git's programs; no view or control changes.
